title: 第11章 血色惊梦废柴少年藏天机第12章 学府大比划水晋级惊众人
lines: 漫天血色铺天盖地，染红了乌江滔滔翻涌的江水，也浸透了边境满目焦黑的土地。
青龙偃月刀死死嵌在孤城东门的断壁之上，刀刃布满密密麻麻的崩裂缺口，却始终笔直指向龙国的疆域，晚风掠过刀身，发出呜呜的低沉悲鸣，仿佛在为陨落的英雄哀恸哭泣。
方天画戟早已断作两截，半截深埋在尸山血海之中，半截被磅礴星力碾作漫天飞灰，无双霸神的身躯早已冰冷僵硬，却依旧定格着一往无前的冲锋姿态。
霸王枪沉入冰冷的乌江江底，裹挟着无尽的不甘与傲骨，随江水缓缓漂流。
八百斤重的擂鼓瓮金锤滚落尘土，表面凝满黑日士兵的脑浆与鲜血，锤柄之上，还残留着主人未曾散尽的温热。
“四神陨，国基崩，蝶梦醒，天下龙。”
苍老沙哑的声响回荡天地，既似九幽之下爬出的诅咒，又像源自洪荒岁月的宿命预言，沉沉压在世间每一寸角落。
庄周猛地从床榻上惊坐而起，浑身冷汗淋漓，胸口剧烈起伏，大口大口地喘息着，仿若刚刚从幽冥鬼门关拼死挣脱。
又是这个梦。
整整三个月，夜夜准时降临，且每一次的画面都愈发清晰、愈发真实，清晰到他能真切嗅见空气中浓稠化不开的血腥味，听见四大战神临终震天的怒吼，触摸到龙国山河倾覆的极致绝望。
他掀开被褥，赤着脚走到铜镜前，望着镜中那张面容清秀、眼底却常年覆着慵懒倦怠的少年脸庞。
十七岁的他，是龙国天元学府炼气班三年级学子。
修行三年始终停留在炼气一层，灵力修为常年稳居年级倒数第三，是全校师生公认的“学府三大废柴之首”。
没人知晓他踏入天元学府的缘由，就连他自己也无从追溯。
只记得三年前，一位白发老者登门递来一封烫金入学通知书，随后化作流光转瞬即逝。
自那以后，他便扎根这座顶级学府，日日上课酣睡、下课失神发呆。
他并非不愿潜心修行，而是心底始终藏着一份忌惮。
体内蛰伏着一股极为恐怖的未知力量，他冥冥中知晓，一旦这股力量彻底苏醒，必将引发天崩地裂的世间浩劫，故而他刻意藏拙敛锋，甘愿沦为人人嘲讽的平庸学渣。
“庄周，你又磨磨蹭蹭的什么？再不去上课，王夫子又要罚你抄一百遍《基础炼气诀》了！”
室友张二狗一边匆忙穿戴衣物，一边扯着嗓子催促。
张二狗是庄周的同班同学，也是他在学府里唯一的挚友。
此人素来不学无术、闲散随性，整日游手好闲，最大的乐趣便是逗弄、忽悠低年级学子的灵石，性子却也算耿直热忱。
庄周淡淡应了一声，慢悠悠洗漱完毕，紧随张二狗的脚步朝着教室走去。
天元学府作为龙国顶尖的修行圣地，能入读此处的皆是万里挑一的修行天才，唯有庄周是个异类。
校园小径上随处可见身着校服的学子，他们三三两两结伴而行，或是切磋武技、或是探讨修行心得，眉眼间满是少年人的自信昂扬。
唯有庄周一身慵懒散漫，与周遭蓬勃热烈的氛围格格不入。
“快看，是那个废柴庄周。”
“修行三年还卡在炼气一层，简直丢尽了咱们炼气班的脸面。”
“换做是他，早就主动退学回乡种地了。”
细碎的嘲讽窃语纷纷入耳，庄周却置若罔闻，依旧步履悠然，不曾有半分动容。
一旁的张二狗却愤愤不平，转头对着议论的学子狠狠瞪去一眼，凶神恶煞的模样瞬间让众人噤声，一个个讪讪离去。
“他们都这么挤兑你，你就一点都不生气？”
张二狗满心不解地抱怨。
庄周浅浅一笑，语气淡然：“生气无用，不如省些力气歇息。”
张二狗无奈摇头，轻叹一声：“你啊，真是烂泥扶不上墙。”
两人抵达教室时，王夫子已然开讲授课。
“庄周，你又迟到。”
王夫子推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，面色阴沉得近乎滴水。
庄周垂首而立，默然不语。
content_en:
The sky was covered in blood, dyeing the surging Wujiang River red and soaking the scorched land on the border.
The Qinglong Yanyue Sword was firmly embedded in the broken wall of the east gate of the lonely city. The blade was covered with dense cracks and gaps, but it always pointed straight at the territory of the Dragon Kingdom. The evening wind passed over the blade of the blade, making a low and mournful cry, as if mourning and crying for the fallen hero.
Fang Tian's painted halberd had long been broken into two pieces, half of which was buried deep in the sea of ​​blood in the mountain of corpses, and the other half was crushed into ashes all over the sky by the majestic star power. The body of the unparalleled tyrant had long been cold and stiff, but it still maintained an indomitable charging posture.
The Overlord Spear sank to the bottom of the cold Wujiang River, carrying endless unwillingness and pride as it drifted slowly along the river.
The 800-kilogram drum, urn, and golden hammer rolled away into the dust, and the surface was covered with the brains and blood of the Black Sun soldiers. The handle of the hammer still retained the warmth of its owner that had not dissipated.
"The four gods fell, the foundation of the country collapsed, the butterfly awakened from its dream, and the world was filled with dragons."
The old and hoarse voice echoed around the world, like a curse crawling out from under the Nine Netherworld, and like a fateful prophecy originating from the prehistoric years, weighing heavily on every corner of the world.
Zhuang Zhou suddenly sat up from the bed, covered in cold sweat, his chest heaving violently, breathing heavily, as if he had just escaped from the hell gate with all his strength.
It's this dream again.
For three months, every night came on time, and each time the images became clearer and more real. It was so clear that he could actually smell the thick smell of blood in the air, hear the thundering roars of the four war gods at their death, and feel the extreme despair of the Dragon Kingdom's mountains and rivers overturning.
He opened the quilt, walked barefoot to the bronze mirror, and looked at the handsome young man's face in the mirror, but his eyes were always covered with laziness.
He is seventeen years old and is a third-year student in the Qi Refining Class of Tianyuan Academy of Dragon Kingdom.
After practicing for three years, he has always stayed at the first level of Qi refining, and his spiritual power has always been ranked third from the bottom in his grade. He is recognized by the teachers and students of the school as "the first of the three losers in the school."
No one knows the reason why he entered Tianyuan Academy, not even he himself can trace it back.
I only remember that three years ago, a white-haired old man came to the door and handed over a gold-plated admission notice, which then turned into a fleeting flash of light.
Since then, he has taken root in this top university, falling asleep in class every day and being in a daze after class.
It's not that he doesn't want to devote himself to practice, but he always has a fear hidden in his heart.
There is an extremely terrifying unknown force dormant in his body. He secretly knows that once this force is completely awakened, it will definitely cause a catastrophe in the world. Therefore, he deliberately hides his weakness and is willing to become a mediocre student that everyone ridicules.
"Zhuang Zhou, why are you so lazy? If you don't go to class, Master Wang will punish you by copying the "Basic Qi Refining Technique" a hundred times!"
Roommate Zhang Ergou was hurriedly putting on his clothes while urging him at the top of his voice.
Zhang Ergou was Zhuang Zhou's classmate and his only close friend in school.
This person has always been uneducated, idle and casual, doing nothing all day long. His greatest pleasure is teasing and fooling the lower grade students' spiritual stones, but his temperament is also upright and enthusiastic.
Zhuang Zhou responded lightly, finished washing slowly, and followed Zhang Ergou's footsteps towards the classroom.
Tianyuan Academy is the top holy land for spiritual practice in the Dragon Kingdom. Those who can enroll here are all talented people who are selected from a million. Only Zhuang Zhou is an outlier.
Students in school uniforms can be seen everywhere on the campus paths. They walk together in twos and threes, competing in martial arts or discussing their spiritual practice. Their brows and eyes are filled with the confidence and high spirits of young people.
Only Zhuang Zhou was lazy and carefree, and was out of tune with the lively atmosphere around him.
"Look, it's that good-for-nothing Zhuang Zhou."
"You've been practicing for three years and you're still stuck at the first level of Qi Refining. It's a disgrace to our Qi Refining class."
"If it were him, he would have taken the initiative to drop out of school and return to his hometown to farm."
Small sarcastic whispers were heard one after another, but Zhuang Zhou turned a deaf ear and continued to walk leisurely, not even the slightest bit moved.
Zhang Ergou on the side was indignant and turned to glare at the discussing students. His fierce look instantly silenced everyone and left one by one.
"They are all pushing you so much, and you are not angry at all?"
Zhang Ergou complained with confusion.
Zhuang Zhou smiled lightly and said in a calm tone: "It's useless to be angry. It's better to save some energy and rest."
Zhang Ergou shook his head helplessly and sighed: "You, you really can't hold up the wall with mud."
When the two arrived at the classroom, Master Wang was already giving lectures.
"Zhuang Zhou, you are late again."
Mrs. Wang pushed up the glasses on the bridge of her nose, her expression so gloomy that it was almost dripping with tears.
Zhuang Zhou stood with his head bowed and remained silent.
title_en: Chapter 11: The bloody dream of the good-for-nothing boy hiding secrets Chapter 12: The promotion in the school competition shocked everyone
